name: Buildxact
summary: Estimating and takeoff for residential builders and remodelers, with quoting and scheduling.
differentiator: Takeoff and estimating are reported to be in every plan, so you do not climb a tier to unlock them the way you do with Buildertrend. Reported pricing is Foundation $199, Pro $399 ($339 billed annually) and Master $599 per month. It targets small to mid-size residential builders and remodelers, not commercial bid work.
pricing: Third-party sources report Foundation $199, Pro $399 monthly or $339 per month billed annually, and Master $599 per month. The vendor pricing page returned an error when checked, so confirm current plans.
bestFor: Residential builders and remodelers who want estimating first.
skipIf: You bid commercial work through invitations to bid.
